props.name: emptyLabel
props.description: Shown over the plot when no series has a sample.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale of the readings and the axis (default `"en-US"`).

props.name: animated
props.description: Play the entrance animation (default false). When false, render the final state.

props.name: fill
props.description:
Make the visual fill the box it is given instead of sitting in the gallery preview frame: drops the frame's side padding, stretches on the cross axis and removes the module's `max-w-*` cap. Off by default, so the preview rendering — and every golden — is unchanged.

Turn it on to use a visual as a panel in an app layout, where a centred, capped card gives mismatched widths and edges from one cell to the next.

props.name: points
props.description: Samples, oldest first, as fractions of the plot (0–1) or as percentages (0–100).

props.name: jitter
props.description: Noise (0–1) that turns `points` into a simulated live signal, which keeps scrolling while animated. Leave it out to draw `points` as they are, with the last sample as the reading.
